title: US backs Japan amid escalating tensions with China over Taiwan
description: BEIJING, Nov 21: The United States on Friday reaffirmed its strong support for Japan, declaring its “unshakable” commitment to the bilateral alliance in response to China’s sharp reaction to Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s comments on Taiwan. title: China-Japan word war could spark a prairie fire
description: WHEN, in her first speech before parliament recently, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi strongly alluded to Japan getting involved militarily in an invasion by China of Taiwan, she did not just sound like she was echoing President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s own apprehension expressed when tensions between China and the Philippines began to simmer months ago in their dispute over the West Philippine Sea.

title: Japan-China spat: Where does this leave PH under a scandal-driven Marcos presidency?
description: WHEN great powers squabble, small states pay the price. And in today’s Asia, the spat is no longer a polite diplomatic dance. It’s an increasingly public, sharp-edged confrontation between Japan and China. Japan’s new prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, with the swagger of someone who forgets the historical lessons and caveats of World War II, declared that Japan may intervene militarily if China “takes over” Taiwan in a way that threatens Japan’s survival and collapses its “pacifist ambiguity” and violates the spirit, if not the text of Article 9 of Japan’s post-war Constitution that renounces war and prohibits the threat or use of force as a means of settling international disputes. In many more ways than one, the statement of Takaichi effectively pre-authorizes war, which is constitutionally problematic and politically and regionally destabilizing. Note that Japan has long relied on strategic ambiguity to maintain deterrence without explicitly committing to war.

title: Taiwan lifts all restrictions on food imports from Japan
